## 📋 Mô tả
Mô tả ngắn gọn về những thay đổi trong PR này.

## 🔗 Liên quan
- Fixes #(issue number)
- Related to #(issue number)

## 🎯 Loại thay đổi
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Code refactoring
- [ ] Performance improvement
- [ ] Security fix

## 🧪 Testing
Mô tả các test bạn đã chạy để verify changes:
- [ ] Unit tests
- [ ] Integration tests
- [ ] Manual testing
- [ ] Browser testing (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)
- [ ] Mobile testing

## 🔍 Code Review Checklist
- [ ] Code follows the project's coding standards
- [ ] Self-review of the code has been performed
- [ ] Code is commented, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] Corresponding changes to documentation have been made
- [ ] Changes generate no new warnings
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally
- [ ] Any dependent changes have been merged and published

## 🚀 Deployment Notes
Có gì cần lưu ý khi deploy không?
- [ ] Database migration required
- [ ] Environment variables need to be updated
- [ ] New dependencies added
- [ ] Configuration changes required

## ✅ Final Checklist
- [ ] Tôi đã test thoroughly
- [ ] Tôi đã update documentation nếu cần
- [ ] Tôi đã kiểm tra không có merge conflicts

- [ ] PR title và description rõ ràng
